author: musho7-dev
subject: Add 3 maps: Sunny Beach, Red Mars, Candy Land
body:
- Sunny Beach (450, 2x coins): sea horizon, golden sand, palm trees
  with coconuts; sand is a little slippery
- Red Mars (1100, 3x): light gravity (600), starry red sky with a
  ringed planet, rocks (no lava)
- Candy Land (2000, 4x): frosting, cream and chocolate layers, giant
  lollipops and gumdrops
- Garage picture tiles for each; 9 maps total
- Lava specks now only on Volcano Ridge
